reference: 通用短S复现样例；仅保留现行纸面样式参数，不含原案件图页
paper_reference: A4 PDF at 100 percent scale; lengths are on-paper, not CAD model lengths
leader_shape: two smooth bends in opposite directions; compact as figure 8 reference 41; one inflection, no hook or repeated waves
length_metric: S body arc length from geometry contact or arrow base midpoint to text end; triangle excluded

preferred_exemplar.scope: Generic reconstruction of the retained numerical style; no client case geometry.

application_policy.default: Place both ordinary leaders and S bodies of primary-arrow leaders near the 6.3 mm nominal length and this curve shape at final output size.
application_policy.orientation: Translate, rotate or mirror the normalized exemplar; retain relative smooth opposite bends. Segment count or curve representation is not prescribed.
application_policy.primary_arrow: Keep previously approved triangle dimensions and geometry-dependent placement; attach the same compact S body. Do not retain the historical 11.55 mm minimum for its S body.
application_policy.clearance: First adjust label placement, view framing, assembly spacing or visible feature anchor. Preserve true target, outer text clearance and neighbor separation.
application_policy.exception: If geometry truly requires a longer leader, keep the compact smooth curve character and record figure, mark and reason. Do not treat the historical 26 mm extent as the new default tolerance.
application_policy.scope: Future patent and disclosure drawings within this skill, across model switches. No bulk revision of the existing case was requested in this turn.

historical_reference_note: Earlier R3 whole-case ranges and medians are preserved as history only. Latest figure-8 mark-41 exemplar takes priority for future lengths and shape.
